999008199.text:
かつては、ランターナの中に
魔物を神と崇めるような街もあった

localizations.en: Once, there were even towns in Lantarna where monsters were worshipped as gods.

999008199.text:
その魔物の性質もあって、
試しに、その都市を経過観察したのだが

localizations.en: Given the nature of these monsters, we decided to observe how such a city would fare.

999008199.text:
やはり、待っていたものは滅びだった。
間違った信仰による結果だ

localizations.en: And as expected, all we witnessed was their inevitable destruction. The price of misplaced faith.

999008199.text:
信仰は星を崇めるものひとつでいい。
他はいらない

localizations.en: The worship of stars alone is sufficient. All other faiths are meaningless.
